messages:
anne-partner: heads-up — we just got the final spec for streaming protocol v2 from runtime. it changes the chunk framing and renames two events (data_chunk -> chunk, stream_end -> end). partners impacted: marketplace connectors, HW SI packages, and several partner SDKs. we need a partner rollout plan.

mike-engineering: thanks. is this a breaking change or additive?

sanjay-platform: breaking for streaming clients that parse event names verbatim. framing is also slightly different: each frame now has a 4-byte length prefix instead of newline delimited.

elaine-pm: timeline? when does runtime want to flip the flag?

mike-engineering: target flip: 2026-05-08 (approx). we can gate behind a feature-flag for 2 weeks of canary in prod. after that we'll flip for all hosted endpoints.

anne-partner: partners need at least 8 weeks notice and a migration shim. many marketplace vendors rely on event names in their webhooks.

sam-devex: we can add a small client-side compatibility shim in our official SDKs that accepts both old and new events for 90 days. but third-party vendors might not upgrade quickly.

elaine-pm: proposed plan: 1) announce to partners + marketplace 2) ship SDK shim + docs 3) 2-week canary with compatible flag 4) flip default 5) 90-day deprecation window after flip. thoughts?

mike-engineering: technical caveats: the 4-byte prefix means existing readline-based consumers will break hard. shim can detect newline vs length-prefix heuristically and adapt. shim adds ~500us per connection on warm path.

anne-partner: do we need marketplace packaging changes? our connectors that run in partner marketplaces will need a version bump and an optional compatibility toggle. I'll coordinate with marketplace team.

partners-bot: Note: marketplace policy requires backward-compatibility warnings in listing pages for any breaking protocol changes.

sam-devex: docs checklist I need: migration guide, code snippets in JS/Python/Go, sample nginx proxy config for binary framing, test vectors, and a small diagnostics script partners can run to detect which framing their consumer is using.

elaine-pm: ok owners: anne — partner comms + marketplace packaging; sam — SDK shims, docs, diagnostics; mike/sanjay — runtime canary + flip; elaine — schedule + partner announcement draft.

mike-engineering: test plan: unit tests for shim, integration tests with simulated newline and length-prefix producers, and a staging integration with 2 marketplace vendors during canary.

anne-partner: I'll start a partner advisory email template. include recommended client versions and a clear rollback path. also ask partners to opt into canary if they want early test windows.

sam-devex: sample snippet (JS shim detection):

```
// peek first 4 bytes
const peek = await socket.peek(4)
if (isAsciiDigit(peek)) {
  // newline-delimited frames
} else {
  // length-prefixed frames
}
```

mike-engineering: rough rollout dates: announce 2026-03-15, SDK shims 2026-03-29, canary start 2026-04-25, flip 2026-05-09, deprecate legacy parsing 2026-08-07. adjust if partners push back.

elaine-pm: please add these to the partner timeline doc and ping legal if we need SLA/contract notes.

anne-partner: noted. I'll loop in marketplace PMs + two SI integration leads this afternoon and send the advisory.

mike-engineering: one more ask — add a telemetry tag on streamed connections so we can measure how many clients still use newline framing after flip. helps us prioritize outreach.

sam-devex: added to SDKs and docs TODO. I'll also publish a small dockerized test harness partners can run.

partners-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: feature-flag rollout window reserved 2026-04-25 -> 2026-05-09 for canary.

anne-partner: thanks all. I'll post the advisory draft in #partnerships later today for quick review :thumbsup:

mike-engineering: thx — please cc eng-releases so they can prepare rollback playbook.

elaine-pm: agreed. meeting for cross-team dry-run next Tue 10am PT. I'll send invite after thread sign-off.
